turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
Orders without custom or pre-order items are typically fulfilled within 2–3 business days. Once your order ships, you’ll receive a tracking link by email or SMS, depending on your preference.

Tracking can take up to 3 business days after shipment to update, excluding weekends and holidays. Custom items, pre-orders, and phone cases may take longer. Hope this helps! 💖

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Once your order ships:

Domestic Priority Shipping: typically 2–7 business days
U.S. Express Delivery: typically 1–2 business days
International delivery: typically 15–20 business days

These timeframes begin on the shipment date and exclude processing time. Weather, holidays, and customs clearance can add time, so they aren’t guaranteed. 💖

turns.replyTail:
Thanks for reaching out to us. Tracking can take up to 3 business days after shipment to update, excluding weekends and holidays. Custom items, pre-orders, and phone cases may take longer.

If it still hasn’t updated after that, send your order number, checkout email, or phone number so I can check the shipment for you 🙂

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks for reaching out to us. Once your order ships, your tracking link is sent by email or SMS, depending on the preference chosen at checkout. You can also check your shipment here: https://account.evryjewels.com/?lang=en

If you don’t see the email, please check your spam or junk folder too. Tracking is only available once the physical order has shipped 🙂

turns.q: My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks for reaching out. Please send your order number, the email address used at checkout, or the phone number used for the order so I can check the delivered shipment and guide you on the next step.

In the meantime, please check around the delivery location, including porches, backyards, and with neighbors who may have accepted it.

turns.q: Do you compensate for a long delay?
turns.replyTail:
For a long delay, the available shipping-fee remedy depends on the service you selected:

U.S. Express Delivery: If delivery takes longer than 2 business days from the shipment date, the shipping fee can be refunded to your original payment method.
Priority Shipping or international shipping: The shipping fee isn’t refunded just because delivery takes longer than expected.

If you’d like me to check your order, send your order number, checkout email, or phone number 🙂
